records.subject: Changing chalcogen X from S to Te in CuMX2
records.quote: Here, we systematically investigate the TE properties of CuMX2 (M = Al, Ga, and In; X = S, Se, and Te) using first-principles calculations.
context_quotes: Electronic transport is computed from explicit electron-phonon coupling based on the Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof (PBE) functional-calculated band structures including spin-orbit coupling (SOC), with band gaps and dielectric constants corrected using the screened hybrid functional Heyd-Scuseria-Ernzerhof (HSE06).

For p-type doping, at a fixed temperature and hole concentration, as X varies from S to Te, the hole mobility (& micro;) increases markedly due to progressively weaker polar optical phonon (POP) scattering, reflecting the reduced ionic contribution to the dielectric response in compounds with heavier chalcogens.
modality_evidence: Here, we systematically investigate the TE properties of CuMX2 (M = Al, Ga, and In; X = S, Se, and Te) using first-principles calculations.

records.subject: CuMSe2, M = Al, Ga, In
records.object: Lower lattice thermal conductivity of CuMSe2 than CuMTe2

For p-type doping, at a fixed temperature and hole concentration, as X varies from S to Te, the hole mobility (& micro;) increases markedly due to progressively weaker polar optical phonon (POP) scattering, reflecting the reduced ionic contribution to the dielectric response in compounds with heavier chalcogens.
Combined with smaller transport effective masses, CuMTe2 compounds therefore exhibit high electrical conductivities (a) and large power factors (PFs).
